|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Knowledge And Defense (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The images here are the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-knowledgeanddefense-pre.gif]]) and the Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-29E-Knowledge_And_Defense.png]]); both show this text. The PC-E1 text is shown by a CardMaker recreation on [[Knowledge And Defense (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]].
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip 29E)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found), page 4, slip 29E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table with up to 12 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Four times per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). Unless canceling your Interrupt, opponent may not play Recoil In Fear until the end of your first turn.” The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) showed the same text (marked “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”).<ref name="cl-1240_31-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013)</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Knowledge And Defense (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) changed “up to 12 cards” to “up to 15 cards” (slip marked E): “Deploy on table with up to 15 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Four times per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). Unless canceling your Interrupt, opponent may not play Recoil In Fear until the end of your first turn.”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=28, page 28. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=28 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee's Holotable card data still had “up to 12 cards” on 29 May and 1 August 2010<ref name="cdf-20100529-dark">Players Committee Holotable card data file, “version 20100529” (darkside.cdf; card data, not a printed source), as committed on 13 July 2010 to [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/darkside.cdf ledwards/swccgvkit] (commit 5047de0)</ref><ref name="cdf-20100801-dark">Players Committee Holotable card data file, “version 20100801” (darkside.cdf; card data), as committed on 1 December 2010 to [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/d14e714/db/darkside.cdf ledwards/swccgvkit] (commit d14e714)</ref> and had “up to 15 cards” by 5 October 2014<ref name="cdf-20141005">Players Committee Holotable card data file, “version 20141005” (card data), inside the Holotable 0.9.9 installer ([https://web.archive.org/web/20190907044537/http://www.holotable.com/download/downloads/holotable-0.9.9_install_linux.tar.bz2 Internet Archive copy]; file dated 2 December 2014)</ref>, which confirms 12 as the earlier count and 15 as the later one. The Players Committee reposted this errata on its rules forum on 30 April 2013, as “already released errata”<ref name="pcforum-p805875">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 30 April 2013 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=20#p805875 forum post])</ref>.
